lightning.model: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, existing NVFP4 checkpoint plus trained rank-16 LoRA
lightning.method: original state-first System One adapter; independently constrained one-token questions; shared prefix cache; concurrency 100 inside each outer request

diffusiongemma.hardware: one L40S, confirmed in active NVCF function instance metadata
diffusiongemma.gateway: existing unified TypeSafe-compatible structured classification gateway

measurement.client: same remote client for both endpoints
measurement.latency: end-to-end wall-clock HTTP including transport, gateway, model, and response scoring; not GPU kernel time
measurement.concurrency: one outer request at a time per backend; matched endpoints called concurrently on separate hardware
measurement.warmup: one excluded call per backend per fixture file
measurement.cache: no flushing or changes to either deployment; sequential existing-service measurements
measurement.lengths: exact Lightning-tokenizer state lengths; identical text for both endpoints; excludes question schema and server template overhead
measurement.percentile: nearest-rank p95; at six trials p95 is the maximum successful latency

data.semantic_gold: Nimble provisional references; all 324 marked human_reviewed=false; holdout used during training evaluation/development
data.long_semantic: 24 deterministic sampled holdout cases, eight per output type, each at 4000 and 12000 state tokens
data.grouped_semantic: 24 previously authored intent, sentiment, and evidence cases; repeated subsets/orders are not new independent cases
data.lookup: seeded random on/off flags and shuffled records; six trials per cell, balanced start/middle/end evidence position
data.padding: repeated neutral office-inventory prose; tests distracting length and evidence location, not realistic long-document comprehension
